perf.page_desc: Monitor ThreadPool performance, task durations, and world context cache.
perf.clear_confirm: Clear all ThreadPool statistics? This cannot be undone.
ut.page_desc: Replace vanilla dialogue with AI-generated lines. Create rules to customize how NPCs speak.
ut.enabled_hint: Master switch for the Universal Translator system.
ut.silent_npcs_hint: Generate TTS for silent NPCs. Requires DBVO to be installed and DBVO.esp disabled or deleted.
ut.dbvo_warning: DBVO.esp is loaded — it must be disabled or deleted for Universal Translator to function.
ut.silent_npcs_warning: Universal Translator requires "Enable TTS For Silent NPCs" to be enabled. Toggle it on above for translations to work.
ut.plugin_filter_desc: Filter voice lines by the plugin that provides them (derived from the voice file path).
ut.global_pattern_placeholder: Speech pattern applied to all NPCs by default...
ut.global_hint: Leave empty to disable global transformation.
ut.no_rules: No rules configured. Click "Add Rule" to get started.
ut.reorder_hint: Drag or select a rule and use arrow keys to reorder
ut.priority_hint_detailed: Rules are evaluated top-down. The first matching rule wins. Use this to override the Global Default for specific NPCs, factions, or races. Leave a rule's pattern blank to disable translation for that entity (useful for excluding specific NPCs from a global translation).
diary.page_desc: Browse, read, and manage NPC diary entries organized by Skyrim calendar date.
diary.enabled_hint: Enable the diary entry generation system.
diary.respect_day_boundary_hint: Only include events from the current in-game day (since midnight).
diary.no_entries: No diary entries yet. Entries will appear as NPCs write them.
diary.delete_confirm: Delete this diary entry? This cannot be undone.
diary.load_failed: Could not load the full entry to edit.
items_spells.items.page_desc: Override item names and descriptions, or hide items from NPC equipment lists in prompts so SkyrimNet will not have NPCs use them. Records ship with plugins too; yours shadow theirs.
items_spells.spells.page_desc: Override spell names and descriptions, or keep spells out of prompts so SkyrimNet will not have NPCs use them. Records ship with plugins too; yours shadow theirs.
items_spells.show_in_prompts_spell: Shown in NPC spell lists in prompts
items_spells.show_in_prompts_spell_desc: Off: the spell is hidden from NPC spell lists in prompts, so SkyrimNet will not have NPCs cast or mention it. The game itself can still use it.
items_spells.revert_confirm_spell: Revert this spell to the version {{plugin}} ships? Your copy will be removed.
items_spells.revert_confirm_spell_builti: Revert this spell to the built-in version? Your copy will be removed.
items_spells.no_nearby_items: No nearby items. Try increasing the search radius.
items_spells.no_nearby_spells: No nearby spells. Try increasing the search radius.
items_spells.revert_confirm_item: Revert this item to the version {{plugin}} ships? Your copy will be removed.
items_spells.revert_confirm_item_builtin: Revert this item to the built-in version? Your copy will be removed.
items_spells.show_in_prompts: Shown in NPC equipment lists in prompts
items_spells.show_in_prompts_desc: Off: the item is hidden from NPC equipment lists in prompts, so SkyrimNet will not have NPCs use it. The game itself can still equip it.
items_spells.record_active_desc: Off: the whole record is ignored, as if it did not exist. A plugin's record is switched off here without editing its file.
agents.delete_confirm: Delete this conversation? This cannot be undone.
agents.welcome_body: Choose an agent from the sidebar to start an intelligent conversation. The assistants can explore game data, answer questions, and help with content.
agents.start_new_body: Create a new conversation or select an existing one from the sidebar to continue chatting with your AI assistant.
agents.chat.subtitle: AI Assistant • Powered by SkyrimNet
agents.chat.start_conversation_body: Type your message below to begin chatting with the AI assistant
agents.chat.input_placeholder: Type your message… (Enter to send, Shift+Enter for new line)
event_monitor.title: Event Monitor
event_monitor.page_desc: Live view of events flowing through the game
event_monitor.dev_warning.title: Development Mode Active
event_monitor.dev_warning.body: Event filtering is disabled. All animation and mod events will be processed. This may cause performance issues during regular play.
event_monitor.feed.title: Live Event Feed
event_monitor.feed.empty_default_msg: Events will appear here as they flow through the game
event_monitor.row.create_trigger_hint: Create a trigger that fires on this event type
event_monitor.badge.short_lived_title: Stored as short-lived scene context event
